back: The protection of data from loss, damage, destruction and unauthorised access.
The right to control who can see and use personal data.
The accuracy, completeness and consistency of data; it is not wrongly changed by error or by an unauthorised person.
Data security protects the data itself; computer-system security protects the hardware, software and network.
Lawful and fair collection, stated purpose, only what is needed, accuracy, limited retention, safeguards.
Read without permission: privacy. Changed wrongly: integrity. Lost or destroyed: security (availability).
The sum of the byte values modulo 256, calculated by sender and receiver and compared.
Two errors can cancel out, so a matching checksum does not prove that the data is correct.
